69
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the August 9, 2005/Sravana 18, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Finance; Panchayati Raj;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Pollution of underground water
†*221. SHRI JANARDAN
DWIVEDI:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the report of the School of
Environmental Sciences of Jawaharlal
Nehru University which says that
underground water is getting highly polluted
due to a landfill arising in the form of hills
in the Capital and in its bordering areas;
(b) if so, the steps being taken by
Government to curb this;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the concrete arrangements being
made by Government to check pollution
of ground water and by when?
Optimum use of runways at Delhi and
Mumbai airports
*222. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO:
SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD:
Will the Minister of CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
major delays for landings and take-offs at
Delhi and Mumbai airports due to lack of
runway space, etc.;
(b) to what extent Government have
been un-prepared for the expansion of air
traffic;
(c) whether Government will take the
best advise possible to create immediate
inter-mediate arrangements using the
existing runway space;
(d) whether it is a fact that the Airports
Authority of India has not used the latest
methods to arrive at optimum use of existing
runway and parking bay space at Mumbai
and Delhi airports; and
(e) the steps proposed to call in outside
experts to devise new systems for use of
runway space, etc.?
Inflow of tourists in Madhya Pradesh
†*223. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
due to constant neglect of main tourist

70
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
centres of Madhya Pradesh, there is
continuous decrease in the number of
tourists going there;
(b) if so, the details in this regard;
(c) whether Government have any
figures regarding the number of foreign
tourists who visited Khajuraho during the
last one year; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Improvement in air traffic
infrastructure
*224. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is a
shortage of ATC offices at most of the major
airports, which is making our airports
unsafe;
(b) what steps have been taken to
improve the infrastructure with 63 per cent
increase in air traffic in the last five years;
and
(c) whether it is also a fact that due to
lack of area control centres there are gaps
in the Indian skies and if so, what steps
have been taken to remove these gaps?
Five point agenda for improvement of
investment climate
*225. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether World Bank has suggested
a five point agenda for improving
investment climate in India which includes
easing restrictions on hiring and firing of
workers and simplification of procedure
for entry and exit of firms;
(b) if so, what are the other points
mentioned in the report;
(c) whether Government have fully
examined World Bank's five point
programme to boost investment in India;
and
(d) if so, to what extent it has been
implemented?
Rain Insurance Scheme
†*226. PROF. R.B.S. VARMA:
DR. CHHATTRAPAL SINGH
LODHA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have launched a Rain Insurance Scheme;
(b) if so, the details of the same; and
(c) the number of farmers likely to be
benefited by this scheme during the current
financial year?
Detection of adulterated cases
†*227. SHRI NAND KISHORE
YADAV: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the petrol
and petroleum products are being
adulterated with the nexus of the officers
of the public sector undertakings;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(c) the details of powers vested with
these officers to stop adulteration and the
number of cases of abuse of these powers
reported during the last three years?

71
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Changes in co-operative sector
legislation
*228. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Panel set up by
Government to suggest changes in the co-
operative sector legislation;
(b) what are the terms of reference given
to the Panel;
(c) by when the Panel is expected to
submit its report; and
(d) whether any suggestions have been
received in the Ministry with regard to
professionalising the functioning of the co-
operatives?
Losses to GIC subsidiaries

Will the M

Total number of questions —155
Explosives detained at IGI airport
1574. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a truck
carrying detonators and large amount of
explosive was detained at Gate No. 17 of
the I.G.I. airport;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether investigation was conducted
to ascertain the  purpose for which that truck
gained entry in the airport premises and
if so, the outcome thereof; and
(d) what action had been taken against
the person who brought that truck with
explosive?
Domestic airport near Delhi
†1575. SHRI AMAR SINGH:
SHRIMATI SAVITA SHARDA:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
SHRI LALIT SURI:
SHRI MANGANI LAL
MANDAL:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any proposal under
consideration of Government to set up
second domestic airport near Delhi;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) by when the airport is likely to be
set up; and
(d) the amount likely to be spent on the
setting up of the airport?
Use of airstrips for civil aviation
1576. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether his Ministry had sought to
make available the airstrips of Kanpur,
Sarsawa (Saharanpur) and Bareilly for the
use of civil aviation; and
(b) if so, the reaction of the Ministry of
Defence thereto?
Fleet replacement programme of  AI
and IA
1577. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
SHRI C. PERUMAL:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

358
(a) whether the Air India/ Indian Airlines
have started their fleet replacement and
expansion programme; and
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the airbus replaced/leased out so far and
those proposed to be replaced and leased
out under the programme?
NOC to PIO for operation of air services
1578. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is lack of transparency
with regard to investment by Persons of
Indian Origin (PIO) in Air Transport
Service sector;
(b) if not, the reasons for not granting
No Objection Certificate (NOC) to PIO
who are treated at par with NRIs;
(c) whether Government have taken the
opinion of the Ministry of Finance,
Ministry of Overseas Affairs and
Department of Industrial Policy and
Promotion with regard to the status of PIO
vis-a- vis NRIs;
(d) if so, the opinion of the above
Ministries, Ministry-wise; and
(e) the steps being taken including
amendment to Aircraft Rules, 1937, if any,
to expedite the grant of NOC to PIO to
operate schedule Air Transport Service in
India?
Implementation of Swagat Seva at
airports
1579. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are evolving a
facilitation service for the airlines on the
lines of 'Marhaba-Welcome' in Dubai;
(b) whether Government have identified
any international airports in the country to
implement this service; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Procedure for import of
aircrafts
1580. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to refer to answer to Starred Question 541
given in the Rajya Sabha on the 3rd May,
2005 and state:
(a) what are Government rules for the
import of aircraft (Private Jets)/ helicopters
by private companies/individuals;
(b) what certification procedures are
followed by the DGCA; and
(c) who is responsible for the
maintenance of such ai rcraft/helicopters
and whether they are approved by the
DGCA?
Air service from Gaya
Airport
1581. KUMARI NIRMALA
DESHPANDE:  Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Gaya Airport is being
equipped properly to receive foreign
tourists, coming from the Eastern-countries;
(b) whether there is any plan to start
direct flights from Tokyo and Taipeh to
Gaya to help tourists from those countries;
and
(c) whether there is any plan to start
domestic flights from Delhi to Gaya on a
regular basis?

359
Development of Pune Chakan
International Airport
1582. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
allow MIDC to develop Pune Chakan
International Airport;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
New international air services

SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are considering to start new air services to
foreign countries;
(b) the number of countries where Indian
air services are operating, at present; and
(c) the names of the countries
